# Noto Emoji sprite source

- Upstream: https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-emoji
- Pinned release: `v2.047`
- Input font: `NotoColorEmoji.ttf`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, reproduced in `OFL.txt`

`res/emoji.png` contains 150 rasterized 16×16 single-codepoint glyphs.
`generated/tg/ui/EmojiData.java` maps Unicode code points to sprite cells.
Both are generated by `tools/generate-emoji.py`; the runtime build never
downloads the font or any other external asset.
